sb_prompt: PLEASE DISCUSS CREDIT CARDS.  FIND OUT HOW THE OTHER CALLER MAKES USE OF CREDIT CARDS.  HOW DO THEY COMPARE TO YOUR OWN?
turns: So, how do you like to use your credit card?
I primarily use mine for online purchases and building up rewards points for travel or cashback. How about you?
I use my credit card mostly for everyday expenses and occasional online shopping. I'm not too focused on racking up rewards, but it's always nice to get some extra perks.

That makes sense. For me, the rewards can really add up, especially when I travel frequently. But I can understand the appeal of using it for everyday expenses as well. What's your preferred credit card brand or issuer? I'm curious to see how our experiences compare.

I've been using a local bank's credit card, and it's been working well for me. No specific brand or issuer stands out, but I do appreciate their customer service. How about you? Do you have a favorite credit card issuer?

좋다!

Issuer isn't a major factor for me, but I do appreciate good customer service. I've had a Visa card for quite some time now, and it's served me well. How about you, do you have a preferred brand or type of credit card?

Do you have any cards that provide such benefits?

번역결과  
저는 눈에 보일하지 않은 잔액 이체 카드와 현금 반환 카드로 오래된 것 같습니다. 저의  spending habits에 부합하기 위해. 나는 어떤 특정 유형의 신용 카드에 대해 강한 선호도가 없지만, 일상적인 구매에 대해 캐시백이나 보상을 제공하는 카드에 대해 높이 평가합니다. 당신은 당신에게 이러한 이점을 제공하는 카드를 가지고 있습니까?

번역결과

My cash back card offers a flat rate of 1% on all purchases, which can add up over time. However, I don't make enough purchases to really maximize the benefits. Do you have a card with a higher rewards rate or special categories where you can earn even more cash back?
